title: salix incana var. angustifolia
intro: Salix incana var. angustifolia, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Willow, is a deciduous shrub or small tree species that belongs to the Salicaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of Salix incana var. angustifolia are attributed to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antiseptic properties, which help to prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, as well as other flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
